subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

Government by two rulers or authorities
solution:
The correct answer is: **Diarchy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Diarchy **means government by two rulers or authorities. (दो शासकों या प्राधिकारियों द्वारा शासन)
 
• The word comes from the Greek words '**di**' meaning two and '**archia**' meaning rule.
 
• Diarchy is a rare form of government, with few examples in history.
 
• The most famous example of a diarchy is the joint rule of Sparta by two kings.

Hence, **option 3** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Monarchy **is a form of government in which a single person, usually a king or queen, holds all the power. (सरकार का एक रूप जिसमें एक ही व्यक्ति, आमतौर पर राजा या रानी, ​​सारी शक्ति रखता है)
 
• **Bureaucracy **refers to a system of government in which officials and administrators manage the day-to-day affairs of the state. (सरकार की एक प्रणाली जिसमें अधिकारी और प्रशासक राज्य के दैनिक मामलों का प्रबंधन करते हैं)
 
• **Anarchy **is a state of disorder and chaos, often resulting from a lack of government or authority. (अराजकता की स्थिति, जो अक्सर सरकार या अधिकार की कमी के कारण उत्पन्न होती है)
